Subject: Re: is a local IMAP server "remote"?

Stefan Palme:
> 
> Hi,
> 
> after reading another recent thread on this list I have question:
> 
> Wietse wrote:
> > Virtual domains are not the correct solution for this.

That was about delivery to a down-stream mail server.

> > For mail that is delivered elsewhere use relay_domains and
> > relay_recipient_maps, and perhaps transport_maps.

Postfix has four address classess.
See http://www.postfix.org/ADDRESS_CLASS_README.html

local = domains in $mydestination, delivered by $local_transport (*),
	users in $local_recipient_maps

relay = domains in $relay_domains, delivered by $relay_transport (*),
	users in $relay_recipient_maps

virtual alias = domains in $virtual_alias_domains, users in
	$virtual_alias_maps, all addresses MUST be aliased to
	addresses in different domain

virtual mailbox = domains in $virtual_mailbox_domains, delivered
	by $virtual_transport (*), users in $virtual_mailbox_domains

default = none of the above, delivered by $default_transport (*)

(*) unless transport_maps say otherwise.

So it has nothing to do with LMTP.

	Wietse
